_comment: Commits the heuristic in unlanded.py flags that a human or orchestrator has already SETTLED, with the settling evidence. The report prints these in their own short section instead of in the unlanded list, so a resuming orchestrator does not re-chase the same commit every five hours. Add an entry ONLY after actually running the command the report prescribes: `git diff <integration> <branch> -- $(git show --name-only --format= <commit>)`. Keyed by abbreviated sha; the value is the reason, and the reason is what makes the entry trustworthy.
c8239748: SETTLED 2026-09-13 (round 23). task/p2-005-device-maturity. The prescribed diff across the one file it touches (tests/test-device-firewall-netns.sh) against roadmap/v2.2 is EMPTY. The heuristic flags it because the file was landed and then rewritten, which is the false positive its own docstring warns about. Content-landed; nothing to do.
dd28fd3d: SETTLED 2026-09-13 (round 23), and deliberately NOT landed. task/followups-4. It adds ROADMAP/state/agents/followups-4.md to the apex-os tree, but ROADMAP/ is not tracked on roadmap/v2.2 — the state directory is snapshotted to refs/wip/roadmap-state instead — so landing it would ship the state directory inside the OS image's repo. The card was extracted with `git show dd28fd3d:ROADMAP/state/agents/followups-4.md` and written to its real path on disk, and the followups-4 agent was told to drop the commit from its branch. If the commit disappears, this entry can go with it.
